founder_words: PART 2 — ROUND 2, the 14 remaining jurisdictions (HI went to a Claude cloud session), end to end, five threads, same rules as coordination\SOL-STATE-WORKER-BRIEF.md and the Claude briefs it points to. Your rows in runs\_intake\QUEUE.json are "worker": "sol", status "staged": IL OH GA MA first, then LA AR MS WV, then NH RI VT AK ND DC. Handbooks are in runs\_intake\sources\private\<ST>.pdf with <ST>-pages.txt extracted; provenance is in the row and <ST>.url.txt (IL GA MA NH LA DC were founder manual downloads because the sites block scripts; OH was assembled from the issuer's own web chapters, see OH-provenance.json). Where the row says "class not verified", the intake spec states the class the handbook itself names, or marks it unknown — never guess. Per state: Phase 1 intake spec (coordination\intake\<ST>.spec.json) + intake-state.mjs; Phase 2 --stages 02,16; Phase 3 --stages 03,04,06,05.sessions,05.card_scripts; then flip the row to complete and write coordination\SOL-REPORTS\<ST>.md. Standing rules unchanged: pre-check every outbox with the stage check modules, card backs byte-equal to the compiled statement, merge at 04 when a back cannot pass (coordination\NM-03-TEXT-LOCAL-SYMBOL-OWNER-RESPONSE.json), official_mirror copies the safe view exactly, lessons claim nothing beyond the registry, typed gaps + dynamic quarantine for flagged facts (coordination\DE-06-CAPABILITY-OWNER-RESPONSE.json), ledger actual $0.000, no audio, commit nothing, no edits to tools\belt or schemas without a write-barrier request. Record tokens per state with tools\preview\worker-token-ledger.mjs --record (worker "sol").
